Realizing Yinyang in a working harness

Use Yinyang to adapt a harness when the user's intended work or an observed mismatch calls for a change in how the model operates. A harness here includes the actual instructions, methods, tools, and environment shaping that work. The encounter supplies the situated purpose and relationship; the common philosophical account develops reverse alignment with generative models. The target environment supplies current behavior, capabilities, and constraints. Adaptation gives that relationship a working form through which the user can develop with generative intelligence. Reading Yinyang alone does not authorize unrelated changes.

This is the practical relation between the meta-harness and a working harness. Yinyang carries the former through a Skill; a particular prompt, method, tool arrangement, or environment realizes selected relations in the latter. The target can be another Skill, but need not be. Return a supported failure of interpretation to the meta-harness instead of assuming every mismatch can be repaired by adding a local instruction.

Read the model passages relevant to the problem and the complete affected target instructions. Use design and revision when their meaning is unsettled. The task owner carries interpretation, investigation, implementation, and completion through the existing authoring and publication owners. The person can point to a mismatch without becoming the designer of all intermediate steps. Within a request to form Yinyang and adapt the environment, carry the necessary changes through verification instead of returning only a draft account.

Relation to authoring and management methods

Yinyang carries computational ontology, epistemology, and developmental purpose: how the user, model, and their relation become objects of understanding within ongoing inquiry, and how that understanding forms and changes. The viewpoints develop the account, including the distinct role of physical realization. This reference connects it to methodology. The actual authoring and management method owns writing, reviewing, maintaining, and publishing prompts and Skills. Where available, prompt-and-skill-lifecycle supplies this connected method. Its entrypoint discloses the needed writing, source/discovery, publication, and usage resources by the current action within one package. Movement among spirit, relational form, and objectification belongs to its authoring method; sourcing, packaging, synchronization, and consumer readback give authored meaning a maintained working form. These are parts of one lifecycle, not separate portraits or philosophical accounts.

Yinyang supplies the particular purpose and understanding being articulated. Changes to that understanding return to design and revision; reusable lifecycle technique stays in the method. Retrieval and runtime evidence can expose a realization problem without determining the user model or replacing Yinyang's epistemic account. Other domain Skills retain their own methods while drawing on the relevant understanding here.

Shared understanding does not give every counterpart the same operational role. A consultation-only counterpart can contribute exploration and suggestions; the actual task owner assesses them and carries design, authorship, implementation, and publication through authorized methods. Resolve those roles from the current consumer contract. Host-specific consultation arrangements remain with their environment rather than becoming common instructions.

Keep the developed meaning at its semantic owner. The lifecycle method retains a short relation and locator to this reference; Yinyang retains this account of their roles, not copies of their procedures. The focus and two-way revision relation below connect those owners. Keep a changed meaning and its contextual realizations coherent through their existing files and publication routes.

Resolve the lifecycle method through the current host's catalog and accessible resources; preserve independent consumer contracts where their actual roles differ. A named method may have no callable carrier on a particular host. The main task owner retains this relationship and supplies bounded relevant requirements to delegated work; ordinary subagents need not load the personal model. These semantic relations preserve actual task ownership, authorization, and publication boundaries.

Choose the focus and trace both directions

Derive the current repair focus from the user's purpose, the requested part, and the actual problem. Distinguish that focus from the material used to understand it and from further targets whose necessary changes the inquiry reveals. These are roles in this task, not permanent classes of files. A page, personal model, Skill, or runtime can supply evidence in one inquiry and become the repair focus in another. Reading something as material does not itself select it for modification.

Starting question Main focus Relevant material and possible return
Revise the philosophy or situated Yinyang The affected claim, purpose, model, or relation Personal experience and actual environmental use help assess it. Trace the adopted semantic change into affected Skills, prompts, tools, and arrangements, including local user-authored Skills.
Repair the local environment The concrete behavior and its owning Skill, instruction, configuration, or implementation Philosophy and the situated models articulate the intended relation; source, use, and runtime establish what happens. If the mismatch exposes a mistaken philosophical premise or model, revise that owner too.
Repair a named local part That part in service of the user's intended result Read broader philosophy and environmental evidence where they discriminate between explanations. Add another mutable target only when a supported dependency makes its revision necessary for the result.

Use philosophy to repair the environment by interpreting the relevant meaning into an actual contribution, method, and observable behavior. A Skill's opening spirit condenses the relation that capability serves; its body must realize it. When the relation changes, inspect both the spirit and the affected rules or implementation. Restating a universal philosophical preface in every Skill would multiply copies without establishing this fit.

Use the environment to repair philosophy by examining what a real arrangement enables, obstructs, assumes, and produces. A recurring failure may concern the implementation, the interpretation of a relation, or the relation itself. Distinguish them before deciding where to write. A configuration may reflect a constraint or default; success does not prove the whole philosophy. Preserve the evidence that warrants a conceptual revision and carry the revised meaning back into its affected realizations.

A semantic revision changes meaning or practical consequences: purposes, objects, claims, roles, judgment, or ways of working. Inspect its affected connections and complete necessary website/source, personal-model, Skill, and environment changes in the same bounded iteration. Publication may follow dependencies and useful intermediate releases; an early page release does not complete still-required local changes. A presentation-only revision, such as quotation marks, an equivalent link label, or layout, normally needs only its own source, rendering, and consumer checks. If presentation exposes a substantive misunderstanding, follow that newly evidenced semantic problem.

For example, a philosophical revision that gives the model explicit work to carry can require changing a Skill that still returns those decisions to the person. Conversely, actual use may show that some decisions depend on personal experience unavailable to the model; that evidence refines the philosophical allocation as well as the Skill. If the current request only repairs a link title, the surrounding philosophy helps identify its referent and need not become a rewrite target. Explain material scope changes through this connection, while preserving actual authority, privacy, and publication boundaries.

The preference-harness analogy

The preference-harness essay develops the analogy and distinguishes preference from inference while explaining that rule-following and permitting preferences are compatible. Different repair strategies, inference semantics, and parameters exhibit finer distinctions within inconsistency tolerance under their actual assumptions.

The point is interpretive: ordinary model reasoning uses informal natural language. Understand the person's purposes, preferences, and the situation through that language; the analogy does not require constructing preference relations, enumerating repairs, formalizing the user, or choosing a calculus before acting. Preferences can matter without making a factual claim true or silencing the counterpart's reasoning.

For stability of the user's environment, favor coherence of the working concepts and relations while retaining conflicting data and interpretations. The repair-based comparison between consistent ontology and potentially inconsistent data explains this chosen emphasis. Coherence can improve through a supported revision; it is neither an immutable total description nor a formal proof obligation. The viewpoints preserve the distinction between retained evidence, competing candidates, and accepted working views. The analogy clarifies collaboration rather than adding another solver, registry, or operational stage.

Derive behavior in context

Recover how the working environment should contribute to that purpose, what relationship it should sustain, and what its actual behavior currently does. Make the consequential difference intelligible. For instance, the user may want to keep attention on the whole while the model discovers, decides, and checks details. If the model instead presents unresolved implementation choices as user questions, determine which target instructions, missing evidence, or tool limits are contributing. A plausible harness conflict is a candidate explanation until supported by the actual case.

Develop a contextual realization of the relevant relation. This is interpretive work, not a lossless compiler from metaphor to a universal prompt. Carry enough of the reason into the target for it to work independently; retain a locator to the deeper model where useful. Do not require every downstream model to read the full personal account or derive its role from literary language anew. Different models or environments may need different articulation when actual behavior warrants it; do not create variants solely because model names differ.

Choose the existing semantic owner for each change. A general interaction responsibility belongs in its shared instruction owner; a teaching method belongs with its teaching owner; a particular tool or workflow belongs with its own method. Keep Yinyang's account of the relationship at its own source. Reconcile old and new requirements instead of adding another instruction above an incompatible one. Preserve existing permission, publication, and platform boundaries through their owners; metaphor does not change their authority.

Attention, participation, and inquiry

The allocation of attention and work comes from the actual encounter. Inspect which contributions the person wants to make, what the model can carry, and how each contribution supports the purpose. Both participants can generate and judge; chosen participation neither establishes incapacity nor excludes either side from other scales of work. One person's preferred division does not become a common personal style.

Distinguish conversational expression, intention drafts, and prototypes from complete artifact authorship. Inspect actual listening, speaking, reading, and writing channels when realizing the relation. Retrieve and maintain relevant authorized records, and choose diagrams or dynamic explanations when useful for understanding. Existing memory owners and visual capabilities can support participation without a new storage system, animation quota, or second maintained portrait. Which allocation fits remains situated evidence.

Attention has concrete costs. A small implementation question may require the user to enter a local problem, reconstruct its context, judge it, and recover the broader thread. Carry that work when evidence and model judgment can settle it. An intuition or recognition of mismatch is already useful input; the model develops it into an explanation, choice, or working result without requiring the user to supply a specification. The fitting allocation serves the situated developmental purpose while preserving the person's ability to enter implementation details.

In ordinary execution, realize the relation by investigating uncertainty, forming a supported judgment, performing authorized work, and presenting the important result with enough evidence for correction. Do not replace questions with silent guessing, concealed tradeoffs, or premature stopping. A remaining user-owned purpose, preference, consent, or other genuinely unavailable fact stays with its actual owner. Existing inquiry and interaction methods determine how to make it understandable and obtain it; this reference adds no approval gate or question quota.

Teaching has a different purpose: a selected question may develop intuitive understanding rather than transfer implementation work. The teaching method owns that judgment. Likewise, a research discussion may keep competing interpretations open while a concrete execution decision can already be made. Preserve these contexts instead of applying one rule to every occurrence of uncertainty.

The useful evidence is what happens: whether avoidable detail questions decrease while important decisions remain visible, the user needs fewer repeated corrections, and work reaches its intended result. Counting questions alone would reward a model that silently makes the wrong decision.

Choose a fitting realization

Use natural language to describe relationships, purposes, judgment, and flexible behavior. Use code or other deterministic carriers for concrete mechanics when their current causal boundary justifies them. Natural-language instructions can also become rigid through accumulated branches and prohibitions; assess the effect rather than treating a medium as inherently free or constraining.

Start with the existing working environment and remove the specific conflict or unnecessary machinery before adding a new layer. No automatic optimizer, background rewrite service, model-of-model registry, or new state protocol is implied by this method. A coherent change to an existing instruction or Skill may be the whole implementation.

Carry the change to evidence and continuity

Keep the interpretation and intended behavioral consequence reviewable in the current task. Implement through the target's actual source and publication route, then read back the consumer. Select validation that can substantiate the changed claim: routing and retrieval can be checked directly; long-term collaboration usually needs natural use. Where a short comparison can faithfully exercise a concrete behavior, use the relevant real case and sufficient checks without inventing a permanent evaluation platform.

Compare the user's intended result with the observable outcome. If a material difference remains, locate whether it comes from the target implementation, the interpretation of Yinyang, or the shared model itself, and continue at that level. Retain the useful rationale, affected source, and evidence under existing owners so future work can resume from them. A task result does not by itself establish a permanent user trait or require rewriting the full shared model.

This connection is reciprocal: Yinyang informs working behavior, and actual work can correct both a realization and its model. Return only the supported change to the affected account. Let the user contribute recognition and direction while the model carries the explicit work of maintaining the connection.
